stations.title: Order book
stations.text: Knows the parcel, answers a moment later.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No way to wait step by step

captions: Slow things answer later now. A customer emails Theo to ask where order WC-1050 is.
The reply is written before the order book answers, so it says [object Promise].
You read promises with then, make your own, and chain each step to the next.
The order book finds the parcel, the tracker finds it delivered, and the reply says so.
Each slow answer is a promise now, and one step waits for the last without nesting.
